[![CI](https://github.com/Hephaestus-Zero/kv-cache-optimizer/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Hephaestus-Zero/kv-cache-optimizer/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) ![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-zero%20(stdlib%20%2B%20optional%20C11)-emerald) ![Antigravity Plugin & Skill](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20%26%20Skill-cyan)

**Why your Gemini 4 Neon cache hit rate is stuck at ~55–75% — and how to push it toward ~80–91% without lowering reasoning quality.**

`kv-cache-optimizer` is a zero-dependency, portable Antigravity **Plugin & Skill** (Linux, macOS, and Windows for auditing) that diagnoses and eliminates client-side KV-cache collapse on short-TTL LLM endpoints (~25s implicit server cache window) — with **zero reasoning downgrade**, **zero mid-turn prefix mutation**, and **zero external packages**.

---

## Architecture

Four orthogonal layers keep active turns under the **`<18s` step budget** (`prev_gen + tool_dur`) and below the **`<150K` context ceiling** without touching model intelligence:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    TURN["Agent Turn (Full Reasoning Effort)"] --> L1["1. Always-On Budget\nrules/AGENTS.md (<18s step, <=2 edits, <150K)"]
    L1 --> CALL{"Tool Call?"}
    CALL -->|"read_file / run_command"| L2["2. Automatic PreToolUse Guard\nhooks.json -> pre_tool_guard (C11 1.2ms / Py -S)"]
    L2 -->|"Big unbounded read_file"| CAP["Narrow to StartLine=1, EndLine=250"]
    L2 -->|"Noisy test/build/lint/diff/log/rg"| CMP["Wrap in compact_run.py\n(<=80 lines on pass, 100% errors kept)"]
    L2 -->|"Bare git log / giant cat"| BND["Insert -n 30 / sed -n '1,200p'"]
    L2 -->|"Pipes, chains, sudo, help, binary"| PASS["Pass through untouched (fail-open)"]
    CALL -->|">=3 hunks or multi-file edit"| L3["3. Atomic Batch Patcher\nbatch_patch.py (single <1.5s step)"]
    CAP & CMP & BND & PASS & L3 --> NEXT["Next Request Arrives with dt < 18s -> Cache HIT"]
    NEXT --> L4["4. Forensic Auditor\ncache_audit.py (--compare-since & --strict)"]
```

For the full mechanics of the ~25s TTL cliff, Gemini's `-2049` chunk-alignment tail, the `>260K` cold-prefill spiral, and the four fix layers, read [architecture.md](./skills/kv-cache-optimizer/references/architecture.md).

## 30-Second Quick Start

Choose whichever adoption level fits your workflow. Always preview with `--dry-run` first if you want to inspect every planned file action.

### Option A — Full Antigravity Plugin (Recommended: Skill + Rule + Automatic Hook)

Installs the complete bundle (`plugin.json`, `hooks.json`, `rules/AGENTS.md`, and `skills/kv-cache-optimizer/`) into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/kv-cache-optimizer` and compiles the `<2ms` native C11 fast-path binary locally if `gcc` or `clang` is present:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Hephaestus-Zero/kv-cache-optimizer.git
cd kv-cache-optimizer

# Preview planned changes (no writes)
python3 skills/kv-cache-optimizer/scripts/install.py --mode plugin --build-native --dry-run

# Install
python3 skills/kv-cache-optimizer/scripts/install.py --mode plugin --build-native
```

*(Prefer manual install? Copy or clone the repo straight into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/kv-cache-optimizer` — Antigravity discovers it automatically, and `pre_tool_guard` works immediately via pure stdlib `python3 -S` even without compiling C.)*

### Option B — Standalone Skill (Personal or Shared Team Workspace)

Install only the skill into your global config (`~/.gemini/config/skills/kv-cache-optimizer`) or check it into any team repository under `.agents/skills/`:

```bash
# Global standalone skill
python3 skills/kv-cache-optimizer/scripts/install.py --mode skill --build-native

# Or share with your team inside any Git repo
mkdir -p /path/to/your-repo/.agents/skills
cp -R skills/kv-cache-optimizer /path/to/your-repo/.agents/skills/
```

### Option C — Audit-Only or Hook-Only

```bash
# Audit-only (nothing installed)
python3 skills/kv-cache-optimizer/scripts/cache_audit.py --model neon --days 14

# Hook-only (merges "kv-cache-guard" into ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json with timestamped backup)
python3 skills/kv-cache-optimizer/scripts/install.py --mode hooks --build-native
```

Use `--config-dir <dir>` with `install.py` to target a custom configuration root.

## Safety & Trust

- **Zero external dependencies**: 100% Python 3 standard library plus an optional single-file C11 binary ([`pre_tool_guard.c`](./skills/kv-cache-optimizer/src/pre_tool_guard.c)). No `pip install`, no Node runtime, no external binaries.
- **100% local & read-only auditing**: `cache_audit.py` reads local transcript JSONL files and prints locally — zero network calls, zero telemetry, zero uploads.
- **Fail-open by design**: Any malformed JSON, missing file, non-UTF-8/binary file, or internal error in `pre_tool_guard` immediately emits `{"decision":"allow"}` with no overwrite.
- **Strict single-intent shell safety**: Never rewrites commands containing unquoted pipes (`|`), chains (`;`, `&&`, `||`), redirections (`>`, `<`), subshells (`$(`, backticks), newlines, `sudo`, `ssh`, `--help`/`-h`, `--version`/`-V`, or already-wrapped commands.
- **Permission & security neutral**: Only adjusts read bounds and noisy stdout verbosity; never weakens or bypasses user permission prompts or security hooks.
- **Instant off-switch & clean uninstall**:
  ```bash
  export KVCACHE_DISABLED=1  # instant bypass without uninstalling
  python3 skills/kv-cache-optimizer/scripts/install.py --mode plugin --uninstall
  ```
- **Zero reasoning quality downgrade**: Never reduces thinking depth, never switches models, and never mutates prior prefix turns.

---

## Honest Limitations

Client-side optimization eliminates **avoidable active-loop waste**, not server-side TTL physics:

| Solvable Client-Side | Not Solvable Client-Side (Server TTL Physics) |
| :--- | :--- |
| Serialized multi-edit bursts (`batch_patch.py`) | Human reading/typing pauses (`>60s` between user prompts) |
| Unbounded `read_file` & verbose `run_command` bloat (`pre_tool_guard` + `compact_run.py`) | Long asynchronous waits (`swarm_wait`, timers exceeding TTL) |
| `>200K–260K` cold-prefill death spirals (`<150K` compaction discipline) | Genuinely deep single-step reasoning (`prev_gen > 25s` — deliberately never throttled) |
| Mid-turn prefix churn & accidental invalidation (`cache_audit.py --strict`) | Turn-0 cold starts, `/compact` resets, and provider load eviction |

## Safety & Trust

- **Zero external dependencies**: 100% Python 3 standard library plus an optional single-file C11 binary ([`pre_tool_guard.c`](./skills/kv-cache-optimizer/src/pre_tool_guard.c)). No `pip install`, no Node runtime, no external binaries.
- **100% local & read-only auditing**: `cache_audit.py` reads local transcript JSONL files and prints locally — zero network calls, zero telemetry, zero uploads.
- **Fail-open by design**: Any malformed JSON, missing file, non-UTF-8/binary file, or internal error in `pre_tool_guard` immediately emits `{"decision":"allow"}` with no overwrite.
- **Strict single-intent shell safety**: Never rewrites commands containing unquoted pipes (`|`), chains (`;`, `&&`, `||`), redirections (`>`, `<`), subshells (`$(`, backticks), newlines, `sudo`, `ssh`, `--help`/`-h`, `--version`/`-V`, or already-wrapped commands.
- **Permission & security neutral**: Only adjusts read bounds and noisy stdout verbosity; never weakens or bypasses user permission prompts or security hooks.
- **Instant off-switch & clean uninstall**:
  ```bash
  export KVCACHE_DISABLED=1  # instant bypass without uninstalling
  python3 skills/kv-cache-optimizer/scripts/install.py --mode plugin --uninstall
  ```
- **Zero reasoning quality downgrade**: Never reduces thinking depth, never switches models, and never mutates prior prefix turns.

## Honest Limitations

Client-side optimization eliminates **avoidable active-loop waste**, not server-side TTL physics:

| Solvable Client-Side | Not Solvable Client-Side (Server TTL Physics) |
| :--- | :--- |
| Serialized multi-edit bursts (`batch_patch.py`) | Human reading/typing pauses (`>60s` between user prompts) |
| Unbounded `read_file` & verbose `run_command` bloat (`pre_tool_guard` + `compact_run.py`) | Long asynchronous waits (`swarm_wait`, timers exceeding TTL) |
| `>200K–260K` cold-prefill death spirals (`<150K` compaction discipline) | Genuinely deep single-step reasoning (`prev_gen > 25s` — deliberately never throttled) |
| Mid-turn prefix churn & accidental invalidation (`cache_audit.py --strict`) | Turn-0 cold starts, `/compact` resets, and provider load eviction |
